en: The Nikkei closed +506 for a 5th straight gain today — but only 40% of stocks actually rose and TOPIX fell 🤔 feels like a handful of chip names are carrying the whole index. Japan's Q2 GDP came in at 1.1% annualized, below forecasts #JapanStocks
